title: A Fish and a Gift
creator: Liesl Jobson, Jesse Breytenbach, Andy Thesen
subject: Juvenile Fiction
description: Yusuf waits on the beach while Papa pushes out his boat. Surfers, turtles and sharks come from the sea. What will Papa bring back for Yusuf?
